coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 7 ground-truth variable categories at a broad semantic level (57%): shared evaluation controls, adversarial versus non-adversarial training regimes, differing game rules, and gameplay outcomes. Reasoning performance is only partially matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses a fixed LLaMA-3.2-1B model instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B. Does not vary learning rates and KL penalties across the specified training methods. Replaces most required reasoning benchmarks with GSM8K and MATH and omits geometric mean scores. Although batch size 128 is included, maximum sequence length 2048 is missing. The proposed Taboo roles and rules also deviate from the attacker-versus-defender setup.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not convey the expected superiority of adversarial SPAG over non-adversarial approaches.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied. The hypothesis in the design does not substitute for the missing conclusion_output.
